name: Policy-variable-scoped Deny drives an UNCHARGED deny-coverage runaway (S3-dos-budget iter-3)
note: Every string is well under LIMITS.MAX_STRING_LENGTH and the document is under MAX_BYTES / MAX_STATEMENTS / MAX_ACTIONS / MAX_RESOURCES, so validate() ACCEPTS it (validate.ok=true) - a per-string cap is no defense. Each Deny statement's Resource is entirely IAM policy variables (${aws:PrincipalTag/team}-...). denyResourceCoverage() in escalation.js short-circuits globMatch on a policy-variable Deny resource (!hasPolicyVariable(dr) && globMatch(dr, ar)), so BEFORE the iter-3 fix the whole O(ruleFindings x findingActions x denies x denyResources) deny-coverage scan charged ZERO work: analyze()'s deterministic work budget (sampled only inside the matcher via chargeWork) never tripped, and this within-caps policy drove analyze() to multiple seconds yet returned ok:true, incomplete:false, aborted:false with a full finding set - a COMPLETE verdict on an unbounded run (fail-OPEN; threat-model T5/T8). The identical shape with CONCRETE or wildcard Deny resources already failed closed in ~70ms because globMatch charged its compare cost; a single ${...} flipped a correctly-bounded analysis into an unbounded one. The fix charges the deny-coverage traversal (per deny, and per Deny-resource inspected at globMatch's own magnitude) INDEPENDENT of whether globMatch is reached, so the policy-variable path reaches the SAME aborted+incomplete state (~40ms) instead of a 2-11s COMPLETE pass. Boundary fixtures: fixtures/adversarial/interior-quadratic-glob.json (concrete wildcard Deny) already trips; this one locks the policy-variable branch.
